page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-96-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-heavy server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. It provides 744 GB of dedicated RAM, equating to 7.75 GB of memory per core. The hardware configuration includes 16 local NVMe SSDs totaling 6167 GB of local storage, with no integrated GPUs.

The underlying Intel Xeon processor operates at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz and features a 504 MB L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate matrix multiplication and vector operations. Cryptographic acceleration is supported via AES, VAES, and SHA_NI instruction sets.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, database operations, and data decompression. It achieved top 10% rankings in PassMark database operations, Redis SET operations (170.8 million operations per second), and static web serving throughput (151.31 GB/sec). Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation also rank in the top tier. However, single-core stress-ng performance and large-model LLM text generation fall into the average tier, indicating a tradeoff where the system is optimized for parallelized, memory-bound, and high-throughput database workloads rather than raw single-threaded compute.

The high density of both memory (744 GB) and local NVMe storage (6167 GB) makes this instance highly resource-dense. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive local scratch space and high memory capacity, eliminating the need to attach expensive external block storage. This profile is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics pipelines, and high-throughput web serving.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-96-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-intensive server instance designed for high-throughput workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores, it features 744 GB of RAM and 6167 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 16 drives. The x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX. In benchmark testing, the instance delivers top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, database operations, and software compilation, achieving 170.8 million Redis SET operations per second. While single-core performance and large-model text generation are average, its massive memory-to-core ratio and local storage density provide excellent qualitative cost efficiency for data-intensive applications. It is highly suited for large databases, in-memory caches, and high-throughput data processing.
